app_identity.name: PetaPembeli
app_identity.tagline: Database Pelanggan & Analisis Geografis TikTok Shop Indonesia
app_identity.target_audience: Indonesian TikTok Shop sellers, e-commerce operators, and customer growth teams
app_identity.emotional_archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY (Warm, Grounded, Tactile, High Trust)
app_identity.design_persona: E1 Anti-AI Designer - Fusion over Imitation, Tactile Warmth, Dense Utility

theme_and_colors.theme_mode: Clean, Warm, Modern Light Mode (with optional dark mode contrast accents)
color_usage_rules: Use #FAF7F2 warm off-white for main page backgrounds to eliminate clinical digital glare.
Use warm Terracotta (#C2410C) strictly for primary actions, highlight badges, and critical key visual anchors.
Use WhatsApp Green (#15803D) for click-to-chat links, WA broadcasting buttons, and customer phone status indicators.
NO purple, violet, or cyan gradients anywhere in the application.
Ensure all text meets APCA high-contrast standards against off-white and surface cards.

typography.font_pairing_strategy: Editorial Warm Utility: Sora for distinctive display titles + Plus Jakarta Sans for crisp, localized Indonesian UI text

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-stone-900 leading-tight
hierarchy.h2_section: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-stone-900

localization_rules.language: All UI text, labels, badges, tooltips, and empty states MUST be in Bahasa Indonesia

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: The Bento Protocol & Dual Density Grid
layout_and_spacing.desktop_density: High density table views with 8px-12px padding for dense customer & order review tables
layout_and_spacing.mobile_density: Generous touch targets (min 44px) and drag-and-drop upload focus
layout_and_spacing.card_borders: 1px solid #E5DEC9 with subtle ambient shadow shadow-[0_2px_12px_rgba(28,25,23,0.04)]

login_onboarding.title: Masuk Akun Seller
elements: Brand hero badge with PetaPembeli logo & TikTok Shop seller illustration
Form input for WhatsApp number / Email and password
Quick demo credential selector button for instant testing
Warm terracotta CTA button with loading state spinner

dashboard_overview.title: Ikhtisar Performa Pelanggan
visual_components: Aktivitas Ekstraksi Terakhir (Recent Screenshot Uploads feed)
Quick Action Cards: Upload Screenshot Baru, Export List WA, Lihat Peta

upload_and_ekstraksi.title: Upload & Ekstraksi Screenshot AI

upload_zone.style: Dashed terracotta border border-dashed border-orange-300 bg-orange-50/40 hover:bg-orange-50 p-8 sm:p-12 text-center rounded-2xl transition-all cursor-pointer
upload_zone.text: Tarik & Lepas Screenshot Pesanan TikTok Shop di Sini, atau Klik untuk Memilih File
upload_zone.formats: Mendukung PNG, JPG, WEBP (Bisa Multiple File sekaligus)

upload_and_ekstraksi.ai_vision_status: Interactive progress bar with stage indicators: 'Membaca Gambar...' -> 'Ekstraksi Teks AI...' -> 'Pencocokan Format & Telepon...'
upload_and_ekstraksi.quick_correct_table: Editable inline review table allowing instant correction of Buyer Name, Phone Number, Full Address, City, Province, Product Name, and Total Price before saving to database.

database_pelanggan.title: Database Pelanggan
features: Search bar with live filtering by name, phone, city, or tag
Deduplication phone badge (Identifikasi otomatis nomor WA sama + indikator Pembeli Setia)
Click-to-chat WhatsApp button (`https://wa.me/62...`) with pre-filled message template button
Tag pills system with customizable colors: VIP, Artis, Influencer, Reseller, Langganan, Bermasalah
Batch actions: Pilih Banyak -> Export CSV / Export List Broadcast WA / Tambah Tag

peta_dan_analisis_lokasi.title: Peta & Analisis Lokasi Pembeli

echarts_map.interactivity: Hover tooltip displaying Province Name, Total Customers, Order Count, and Total Spending (Rp). Click province to drill-down into Cities/Regencies bar chart.

peta_dan_analisis_lokasi.ranked_charts: Top 10 Ranked Horizontal Bar Charts for Provinces and Top 10 Cities with highest buyer concentration.

analisis_creator.title: Analisis Creator & Affiliate
components: Creator performance summary cards (Top Affiliate by Revenue, Top Affiliate by Conversion Volume)
Interactive Creator Table with niche tags (Fashion, Beauty, Skincare, Kuliner, Electronic, Lifestyle)
Revenue attribution chart and repeat order contribution percentage

perlu_di_ss.title: Perlu Di-SS (Gap Analysis)
perlu_di_ss.concept: Identifies orders present in TikTok Shop CSV export that DO NOT YET have screenshot visual data captured by AI vision.
features: Gap count summary banner ('24 Pesanan Belum Memiliki Details Screenshot')
Filterable list by order date, buyer name, and order value
Quick upload button targeted directly to missing order IDs

segmen_dan_export.title: Segmen & Export Data
filters: Jumlah Pesanan (Pembeli Baru vs Repeat Buyer 2+ kali)
export_options: Export CSV Lengkap (Format Excel / Google Sheets)
Export Format Nomor Kontak WhatsApp (.vcf / CSV Broadcast)
Salin Teks Daftar Nomor WA (Quick Copy ke clipboard)

pengaturan.title: Pengaturan Sistem
tabs: Aturan Normalisasi Wilayah (Auto-correct penulisan kota/provinsi typo)
Manajemen Tag & Warna (Ubah tag VIP, Artis, Bermasalah)

tentang.title: Tentang PetaPembeli
tentang.content: Informasi versi aplikasi, petunjuk penggunaan ekstraksi AI, tips keamanan data seller TikTok Shop, dan kontak dukungan teknis.

customer_detail_drawer.title: Detail Pelanggan & Riwayat
features: Customer profile header with total lifetime spend and order count
Custom tags selector with instant toggle
Catatan Khusus (Seller notes textarea with timestamped history)
Timeline pesanan ter-ekstraksi dengan preview thumbnail screenshot

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill or clean 8px rounded buttons. Primary: bg-orange-700 hover:bg-orange-800 text-white font-medium shadow-sm transition-all. Secondary: bg-stone-100 hover:bg-stone-200 text-stone-800 border border-stone-300.
component_guidelines.badges: Custom pill badges with subtle backgrounds (e.g. VIP: bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-300; Pembeli Setia: bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300; Bermasalah: bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-300).
component_guidelines.tables: Dense, crisp tabular display with striped/hover states, sticky headers, text-stone-900 typography, explicit column widths, and pagination/page size selector.
component_guidelines.toasts: Use Sonner toast notifications in Bahasa Indonesia for save, upload, export, and delete actions.

merchant_avatars.description: Pak Budi - Owner Toko Fashion Batik
Ibu Siti - Owner Snack & Kuliner Nusantara
Siska - Top TikTok Shop Affiliate Creator

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive components use the specified data-testid attributes for E2E testing.
Do NOT use purple or violet gradient styles.
Format currency in Rupiah (e.g., Rp 1.250.000) and dates in Indonesian format (e.g., 18 Juli 2026).
Keep all UI copy strictly in Bahasa Indonesia.
Use ECharts for the 38 provinces Indonesia choropleth map and ranked bar charts.
Make the screenshot upload zone highly functional with drag-and-drop support, mock AI extraction progress, and a quick-correct table.
